country.name: Suriname
country.languagePolicy: Dutch is the default interface language, not a substitute for a learner's home language. Sranan Tongo, Indigenous, Maroon and other community languages have distinct contexts. Language and cultural adaptation require participation by the relevant community; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Surinamese reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible Ministry, district or interior-education authority, NOVA, community, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: Suriname has a centralized education system coordinated, directed and regulated by the Ministry of Education, Science and Culture. Public and private schools operate across primary, junior and senior secondary, vocational and tertiary layers. Interior education has specific administration. Higher-education program accreditation is governed separately through NOVA.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (MinOWC)
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve school name, district, locality, public or private management, level, school type, source-file date, current status and review date. A Ministry list is a dated discovery source, not proof of current operation or every offered program.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional legal status, permission to operate, diploma recognition, program accreditation, accreditation decision, recovery period, validity dates, awarding authority and professional recognition are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur
authorities.role: central education governance, regulation, policy, school information, curriculum and statistics

authorities.name: Directoraat Algemeen Vormend Onderwijs
authorities.role: coordination of public basic and general secondary schools, curriculum development, monitoring and interior education

authorities.name: Onderdirectoraat Onderwijs Binnenland and education bureaus
authorities.role: education organization in Marowijne, Brokopondo and Sipaliwini with inspection and school-support structures

authorities.name: Nationaal Orgaan voor Accreditatie (NOVA)
authorities.role: accreditation of existing and new higher-education programs and diploma recognition within its legal remit

authorities.name: Anton de Kom Universiteit van Suriname
authorities.role: public university operating under its governing legal and institutional authority

authorities.name: Suriname National Training Authority
authorities.role: national vocational qualification and training quality functions within its mandate

authorities.name: Bureau Familierechtelijke Zaken, Bureau Rechten van het Kind and competent child-protection bodies
authorities.role: child-rights and safeguarding coordination within their current legal mandates

curriculum.authority: MinOWC, its curriculum-development service and responsible education directorates
curriculum.title: Suriname national curriculum, curriculum frameworks and current implementation materials
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm education level, year, subject, school type, curriculum framework, document version, pilot or national implementation status, effective school year, assessment authority, district and school context before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Policy plans, curriculum frameworks, textbooks, examination syllabuses, vocational competency standards and external resources are different layers. A policy intention or pilot must not be presented as an effective nationwide curriculum, and external material must not silently replace current MinOWC guidance.

schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The Ministry page links a school list for GLO, VOJ and VOS, while vocational schools have a separate source. A listing does not by itself prove current operation, authorization of every program, current management, or current contact information.

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display school year or observation year, publication or update date, measure, definition, unit of analysis, population, level, district, management sector, source and filters. A figure quoted in a later policy plan retains its original observation year and must not be described as current.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: MinOWC and NOVA according to the exact claim
higherEducation.authorityNotice: NOVA explicitly distinguishes recognition from accreditation. Institutional existence or recognition, permission to operate, diploma recognition, and accreditation of a named higher-education program are separate. Each program claim must preserve institution, exact program, decision status, start and end dates, recovery period or pending status, remarks, site and modality; an accredited program does not make every program at the institution accredited.

privacyAndSafeguarding.privacyDraft: Draft Wet Bescherming Privacy en Persoonsgegevens
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: The publicly indexed privacy text is marked ONTWERP and must not be represented as enacted law without an official promulgation source. Applicable constitutional, civil, criminal, education, communications, child-rights and institutional duties; lawful basis; notice; security; consent or authorization; safeguarding; incident response; referrals and cross-border transfers require qualified Surinamese legal review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: MinOWC policy calls for attention to multilingualism, equality and cultural diversity, but implementation must be verified by level, school and community. Dutch, Sranan Tongo, Sarnami, Javanese, Maroon and Indigenous languages must not be treated as interchangeable. Language, orthography, culture, territory, curriculum and community governance require review with the relevant community, especially for interior education.

completionCriteria: A qualified Surinamese education reviewer is named.
MinOWC, directorate, district or interior-education, NOVA, TVET, community and institution responsibilities are correctly assigned.
Every school record preserves district, locality, management, level, school type, source date, current status and review date.
Every statistic shows observation year, publication date, definition, population, level, district, management sector and provenance.
Curriculum mappings identify level, year, subject, framework, version, pilot or implementation status, effective year and school or community context.

Every higher-education claim distinguishes recognition, permission to operate, diploma recognition, exact program accreditation, status, validity dates, recovery or pending status, awarding authority and professional recognition.
Multilingual, Indigenous, Maroon and interior-education requirements are reviewed with the relevant community.
Privacy-enactment status, child-protection, education and institutional obligations are reviewed by qualified Surinamese counsel.
Accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
